## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome.

## Target branch

- [ ] `develop` for feature, bugfix, documentation, or infrastructure work
- [ ] `main` for a release or hotfix only

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting check passed
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passed
- [ ] `flutter test` passed
- [ ] Android/iOS build checks passed when required

## Project integrity

- [ ] Tests cover changed deterministic learning behavior
- [ ] Database changes include an explicit migration and migration test
- [ ] Analytics changes use the centralized event map
- [ ] Relevant `docs/` handoff files are updated
- [ ] No draft content is promoted without human review
